## wip.pull
Entry: Planka row `n8n-wip-pull` (events cardMoved, customFieldValueUpdate) POSTs every card move / custom field write of every board to /webhook/wip-pull?event=&board_id=&list=&card_id=. Not a card-type flow: no card type, no capability, no agents.
Trigger: Webhook (responds on receipt; in-cluster, no auth, like the card flows).
Purpose (R346, George 2026-11-03): pull cards from TODO into READY by the project's WIP limit without touching the templated <card_type>.<LIST> flows.

## How it works
1. Event filter: act only on cardMoved, or on customFieldValueUpdate whose field is card_type on a card in TODO. Else stop.
2. Resolve project (RM getProjectByPlankaBoard) -> Link check: 404 (board not linked) = not a conveyor board -> stop silently; any other RM error throws (the pull is not silently lost). WIP N = effective_wip_limit (null = no limit; 0 = paused for work cards).
3. Get board: every card with its list, card_type, phase and Relations.requires (JSON array of Planka card ids).
4. Select pulls: busy = cards in READY + DOING. Candidates = TODO cards with a card_type whose every requires id is a card in DONE (malformed requires = not pulled), by Planka position ascending.
5. Structural types bypass WIP: project_start_request_analysis, project_setup, project_phase_start.
6. project_phase_closure / project_closure: pulled only when every other non-closure card is in DONE (DROPPED cards ignored); they bypass WIP.
7. Work cards (everything else): pulled by WIP only (R347: no coverage card; project_phase_start judges coverage before its sign-off): only while busy < N, at most N - busy per run.
8. Move to READY (Planka card update listId). Each move fires its own <card_type>.READY flow through the existing Planka row.

## Gates and exit
Gates: Act? (event filter), Conveyor board? (RM link), Select pulls emitting zero items = nothing to pull.
Exit: the chosen cards are in READY; nothing else is written.
Each move fires cardMoved, which re-runs this flow; a re-run finds the card already out of TODO, and a move to the list a card is already in fires nothing, so concurrent runs converge.
